subject: Re: Helix AI pilot — extension request and discount ladder proposals
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@helixai.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Carver <tcarver@helixai.com>, procurement@helixai.com
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Helix pilot — short extension & potential discount ladder

Hi Jordan,

Quick note from Helix following our internal demo last week — engineering needs another week to complete a throughput test for the anomaly-detection workflow. We are at ~85% of the target but one of our microservices is regressing at higher concurrency; we need to run a full 48-hour burn to be confident.

Two asks:
- Can Redwood extend the pilot by 7 business days (no additional charge) so we can finish the burn?
- If we convert to a 6–12 month reserved pool within 30 days of pilot close, would Redwood consider a laddered discount (higher commit => higher unit discount)? Tom mentioned this in the demo and we want a concrete structure to show procurement.

If you want, I can loop procurement for a quick checklist. We’re targeting an exec sign-off if the numbers work.

Thanks,
Samantha
Samantha Lee
Head of ML Engineering, Helix AI
(Attachment: helix_failure_log_snippet.txt )

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@helixai.com>
Cc: Tom Carver <tcarver@helixai.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Helix pilot — short extension & potential discount ladder

Hi Samantha — appreciate the update and congrats on the progress.

Short answers up front: we can do a one-week complimentary extension while your team completes the 48-hour burn. For the larger ask (laddered discounts on conversion to Reserved capacity), I’ve looped in Kimberly (sales ops) and David (pricing) so they can sketch concrete tiers.

Proposed next steps:
1) We’ll provision the extension now and set the pilot end date to 2026-03-16.
2) David will share a 3-tier ladder (e.g., 10% / 17% / 25% off hosted unit rates tied to 3/6/12m GPU commit) and an example math model.
3) If that looks good, Kimberly will prepare a short addendum + PO template you can send to procurement.

Does that timeline work for you? If you prefer a longer runway we can consider a one-off credit instead of a complimentary extension — that’s more likely if procurement needs an approval path.

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: none)

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@helixai.com>, Tom Carver <tcarver@helixai.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Helix pilot — short extension & potential discount ladder

Jordan/Kim — draft pricing ladder attached (pricing_ladder_v2.xlsx). Outline below so Helix has a single-slide view for procurement:

- Option A (Low commit): 3-month reserved, ~8 GPUs effective -> 10% unit discount vs hosted list 
- Option B (Medium commit): 6-month reserved, ~20 GPUs effective -> 17% unit discount + 1 free burst day per month
- Option C (High commit): 12-month reserved, ~40 GPUs effective -> 25% unit discount + priority capacity lane + 2 free burst days/month

Notes and protective language:
- Discounts apply to usage-only line items for the reserved pool; add-ons (observability retention, premium SLAs) are quoted separately.
- If Helix converts within 30 days of pilot close we can honor the above ladder; if conversion falls between tiers we’ll pro-rate to the nearest tier.
- For the complimentary extension, we’ll record a one-week day-0 push and no extra billing. If Helix prefers credits (to be used against conversion invoice), we can offer a 10% credit of pilot spend up to $12k instead.

Kim, can you draft the addendum and a single-page SOW for procurement? I’ll flag the deal in the finance queue once Helix confirms which option they want.

Thanks,
David
Director, Pricing & Revenue Operations
(Attachment: pricing_ladder_v2.xlsx)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@helixai.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 10:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Helix pilot — short extension & potential discount ladder

Hi Samantha — looping procurement language and next steps below to make approvals as smooth as possible.

Procurement checklist (for Helix):
- Signed pilot addendum (attached: helix_addendum_draft.pdf) — confirms new pilot end date (2026-03-16) and conversion window.
- PO referencing Redwood addendum or DocuSign envelope id (we can generate a PO-friendly DocuSign link).
- Billing contact and tax details if you plan to convert to Reserved.

DocuSign: I can create an envelope with the addendum and our standard reserved plan SOW once you confirm Option A/B/C. If procurement needs a consolidated quote, use this link (we’ll also send a HubSpot quote): https://www.docusign.com/helix-addendum-4821

If Helix accepts Option B (our most common mid-stage), David recommends a 6-month ramp plan and we’ll include 1 free burst day/month as noted. If you want the credit instead of a complimentary extension, tell us and we’ll issue a $12k credit memo contingent on conversion.

Kimberly Park
Senior Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: helix_addendum_draft.pdf, po_template.docx)

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@helixai.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Carver <tcarver@helixai.com>, procurement@helixai.com, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2026 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Helix pilot — short extension & potential discount ladder

Thanks everyone — we reviewed internally. Quick answers:
- We’ll take the one-week complimentary extension and complete the 48-hour burn by 2026-03-15 (appreciate the flexibility).
- Procurement likes the Option B structure (6-month reserved, mid-tier) but wants the discount ladder language and the free burst day explicitly in the addendum.
- We prefer the credit route instead of a complimentary extension only if it reduces the conversion invoice; but given your offer, complimentary extension + Option B looks cleaner for our sign-off flow.

Action items for Redwood: please send the final addendum with Option B populated and a DocuSign envelope. Procurement: we will issue a PO once the DocuSign is completed.

I’ll confirm final exec approval by 2026-03-17.

Best,
Samantha
Head of ML Engineering, Helix AI
(Attachment: none)
